title: Brown planks
doc: The wood set: Poly Haven's brown_planks_03 at 2K, colour, normal, roughness, ambient occlusion and a 16-bit height; a plain dielectric, the grain's anisotropy left to a later standard.

provenance.source: Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_planks_03 (CC0 1.0), fetched 2026-10-04 at 2K by tools/fetch_polyhaven.py; the set's LICENSE.md names the authors
provenance.note: base_color, specular_roughness, geometry_normal, ambient_occlusion, height: each binds the set's map of that name; base_color and specular_roughness carry the factor 1.0 because legacy v2 multiplies the sample by the factor; the IOR is the family's 1.5
